description: Agent Aviation Records: submit pilot certificate records with the flight log and fleet record they answer to: each aircraft the fleet record lists with its id, tail number and type; each pilot certificate record with its id, certificate reference, pilot, grade, the aircraft types and the operations it covers and the moments the certificate and the medical lapse; each flight log entry with its id, reference, tail number, aircraft type, pilot, the operation flown and the moment flown. The signed report gives the flights and the certificates, each flight against a certificate record of its pilot covering the aircraft type and the operation flown, each covered flight against the certificate and medical dates on the day flown, and each pilot in the flight log against a certificate record on file, and counts them, and names divergent pilot certificate records: a flight logged by a pilot whose certificate record does not cover the aircraft or the operation flown, a certificate or medical date in the record already lapsed at the flight date, and a pilot in the flight log with no certificate record on file; then a flight whose aircraft type neither the entry nor the fleet record gives and a certificate record stating no medical date beside its pilot’s flights, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No flight log entries, or no certificate records beside flights that name a pilot, leaves those points unverified. Pilots match by reference or name, aircraft types and tail numbers by letters and digits, so PC-12 and PC12 are one type, operations match by their words, the aircraft type flown is the entry’s own or the fleet record’s for its tail number, a record listing no types or no operations covers any, and a certificate or medical lapses after the day it states. This reads whether every flight was flown by a pilot whose certificate covered the aircraft and the operation, with the certificate and the medical current. Verdict aviation_pilot_certificate_divergent, aviation_pilot_certificate_partial, aviation_pilot_certificate_unverified or aviation_pilot_certificate_consistent. POST /api/aviation-pilot-certificate-check. Reads the aviation records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it flies no aircraft, inspects no aircraft in person, contacts no regulator, examiner or maintenance provider and issues no certification, which stay with the operator, its pilots, its mechanics and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Aviation Records reads an air operator’s own records: flight log records, aircraft maintenance records, airworthiness and directive records, inspection records, pilot certificate records, training and currency records, flight duty and rest records and incident report records, each against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records, the mechanic, certificate and part records, the flight log and the maintenance record, the aircraft, operations and dates flown, the schedule and the corrective entries, the required events and the currency records, the operator’s own limits, or the follow-up entries on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the aircraft and the crew: what the flight log shows, what the maintenance record supports, what the certificates cover, and whether the duty and incident records hold up; it reads records about aircraft and crews, not live flight tracking and not travel booking: the Agent Travel family reads the bookings behind a trip, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records and the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file, while this family reads an air operator’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-aviation-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-aviation-records/.
